name: Champion's Arrival extends both Chains of Light and Champion of the Sun by 5 sec (#2442)
contract: Champion's Arrival 704905 (SpellFamilyName 33) is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), SPELLMOD_DURATION (1), EffectBasePoints 4999 -> real 5000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask (0x4000, 0x800, 0x100000). Word 1 (0x4000) matches Chains of Light's own effect spell (806697, SpellFamilyFlags_1 0x4000, DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms), so SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod already admits it and the native Player::ApplySpellMod(806697, SPELLMOD_DURATION, base) path (queried directly here with 'spell_modifier', the same call Spell::CheckCast's duration calculation makes) already returns 15000 -> 20000 with no code change. Words 2 and 3 (0x800, 0x100000) do not match Champion of the Sun (800612, SpellFamilyFlags_1 0x20 only): scanning every family-33 record for those two bits instead finds 'Twilight' (707612, 712445) and 'Holy Form' (805301) / 'Vow of the Valkyr' (807751) -- none of them Champion of the Sun -- so that half of the SpellMod can never reach 800612's own 25000 ms self-buff (DurationIndex 63). aura_ascension_champion_of_the_sun_arrival (registered on 800612 itself) extends the aura by 5000 ms directly on AfterEffectApply when the caster knows 704905, using the same Aura::SetDuration/SetMaxDuration pair AscensionSunCleric::Extend already uses elsewhere for this exact purpose. 'set_aura' applies 800612 through the normal Unit::AddAura path, so the hook fires the same way a real cast would.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without the talent Chains of Light keeps its own 15 second duration
Champion's Arrival extends Chains of Light to 20 seconds
Control gains Champion of the Sun as a fixture
The talented Sun Cleric gains the same buff
Without the talent Champion of the Sun keeps its own 25 second duration
Champion's Arrival extends Champion of the Sun to 30 seconds
